description: This Java source file defines the ResourceReferenceConverter class, which handles conversion and resolution of Android resource references within an IntelliJ IDEA plugin environment. It manages resource types, reference creation, variant generation, and quick fixes for Android resource attributes.

classes.name: ResourceReferenceConverter
classes.description: A converter class for handling Android resource references, supporting variant generation, reference creation, quick fixes, and documentation within an IntelliJ plugin.

methods.name: getVariants
methods.description: Generates possible resource reference variants based on the current context, resource types, and existing resource files.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Parses a string into a ResourceValue object, handling references, literals, and attribute references according to configuration.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts a ResourceValue object back into its string representation.

methods.name: getQuickFixes
methods.description: Provides quick fixes for missing or incorrect resource references, such as creating new resource files or values.

methods.name: createReferences
methods.description: Creates PSI references for resource values, enabling navigation to resource definitions.

methods.name: getDocumentation
methods.description: Returns documentation for a given resource reference value.
